lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiHg crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms (Li₂Hg₂) and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Hg and Li centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; each Hg is coordinated by 4 Hg and 8 Li neighbors, while each Li is coordinated by 8 Hg and 4 Li neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from 3.0269 to 3.0743 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Hg–Hg and Li–Li 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
